channel.title: Federal News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Federal News Network (federalnewsnetwork.com)

item.title: For agency CIOs, it’s all about the money
item.description: Ann Dunkin, the former Energy Department and EPA CIO, says agency technology leaders need direct control over agency IT budgets to be most effective.

item.title: Army set to debut new ‘campus-style’ dining model, beginning with Fort Hood
item.description: In order to open the revamped dining facility, the Army had to obtain numerous waivers from current law and DoD policy.

item.title: How a DHS shutdown affects different components and employees
item.description: Roughly 90% of DHS employees continue working through a shutdown. Many have to show up without getting paid. Here's how each component is impacted.

item.title: OPM directs agencies to move forward with ending collective bargaining
item.description: Amid ongoing legal action, a new OPM memo tells agencies to proceed with ending collective bargaining agreements with federal unions under orders from Trump.

item.title: No clear path to ending the partial government shutdown as lawmakers dig in over DHS oversight
item.description: Lawmakers and the White House are offering no signs of compromise in their battle over oversight of federal immigration officers.

item.title: Sovereign AI is a geopolitical reset — and telcos need to deliver it
item.description: As governments scramble to reclaim digital control, this isn’t just about data localization or regulatory fences, but architectural rewiring of power itself.

item.title: Time for the eBuy wall to come down, once and for all
item.description: GSA kicked off market research for two new broad-based IT contracts, but only certain vendors had access to the details and were able to respond.

item.title: Postal union president focused on keeping USPS an ‘affordable option,’ amid agency’s financial woes
item.description: Jonathan Smith, president of the American Postal Workers Union, told Federal News Network USPS should focus on affordability to win back customers.

item.title: House Democrats criticize ‘devastating’ federal workforce cuts, seek path forward
item.description: A year after the Trump administration told agencies to compile headcount reduction plans, House Democrats reflected on wide-ranging consequences.

item.title: Stopgap funding measures cause delays, increased costs, administrative burden across DoD
item.description: The Government Accountability Office surveyed about 74 acquisition programs. Roughly half experienced scheduling delays or financial impacts.
